description.value: Rossland Outdoor is a locally owned gear shop founded by Jason and Erik, two industry veterans with over 30 years of experience each, focused on mountain biking and skiing in the Monashee Mountains. The shop carries Specialized and Norco bikes and offers full bike service and repair for riders tackling Rossland's renowned singletrack and the Seven Summits trail system. Touring cyclists will find knowledgeable staff with genuine firsthand experience on local trails.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active local bike and ski shop with 'full ski and bike service and repair' and mentions staff helping with mid-season fixes, supporting the mechanicals criterion. The website lists the address as 2040 Columbia Ave. while OSM records 2042 — a discrepancy flagged below. The business name in OSM is 'Rossland Outdoor Store' but the website consistently uses 'Rossland Outdoor' without 'Store'.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists 2042 Columbia Avenue but website consistently shows 2040 Columbia Ave. — likely a typo in one source; should be verified on-site.
Name mismatch: OSM records 'Rossland Outdoor Store' but the website uses 'Rossland Outdoor' (no 'Store') throughout all pages.
OSM record has no phone number; phone (+1-778-457-1234) sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Full-service bike and ski shop in a major mountain biking destination with confirmed repair services and knowledgeable staff — a clear benefit to touring cyclists passing through Rossland.

wow_evidence: locally owned … full ski and bike service and repair … knowledgeable staff with genuine firsthand experience on local trails
